name: copilot-telemetry
why: Copilot sends usage telemetry to its own endpoint.

job.purpose: GitHub Copilot CLI's own use of this token: Copilot AI requests (its entitlement, policy and settings checks under api.github.com/copilot_internal, listing models, chat and completions, and telemetry under githubcopilot.com) and light read-only GitHub queries, such as reading a file or searching code; nothing that creates, changes or deletes anything on GitHub

statements: allow read on Copilot settings in service "api.github.com"
allow read on model in service "api.individual.githubcopilot.com"
allow create on chat completion in service "api.individual.githubcopilot.com"
allow call on read-only MCP tool in service "api.individual.githubcopilot.com"
allow create on telemetry event in service "telemetry.individual.githubcopilot.com"
allow read on anything in service "api.github.com"
deny create, update, delete on anything in service "api.github.com"

definitions.Copilot settings: Copilot CLI's entitlement, policy and settings, under /copilot_internal.
definitions.chat completion: A Copilot chat or completion request: a prompt sent and the model's reply.
definitions.model: A model Copilot offers, as its model listing names it.
definitions.read-only MCP tool: A tool of GitHub's read-only MCP server, POST /mcp/readonly, each of which reads GitHub and changes nothing.
definitions.service: An HTTP API, named by its host.
